units.source_text: 无论从她昨晚同站长谈话时那种亲昵的口气，还是从她身上穿的雪裤来看，叶子显然是这附近地方的姑娘。

en.t: Judging both from the familiar tone she had used when speaking with the stationmaster the night before and from the snow trousers she wore, Yoko was clearly a girl from somewhere nearby.

units.source_text: 那条花哨的腰带在雪裤上露出了一半，所以雪裤红黄色和黑色相间的宽条纹非常显眼，因而毛料和服的长袖子也显得更加鲜艳了。

en.t: The flashy sash showed halfway over the snow trousers, so the broad red-yellow and black stripes of the trousers stood out sharply, making the long sleeves of her wool kimono look even brighter.

units.source_text: 裤腿膝头稍上的地方开了叉，看起来有点臃肿，然而却特别硬挺，十分服帖，给人一种安稳的感觉。

en.t: The trouser legs were slit a little above the knees and looked somewhat bulky, yet they were especially crisp and sat neatly, giving an impression of steadiness.
